summary: Assessed inventory: Uno R3 can be reused for basic Android Bluetooth RC car; ULN2003/relay unsuitable as reversing brushed DC motor driver. Recommend 2WD TT geared motors + 2 wheels/caster/chassis, TB6612FNG dual H-bridge (verify motor stall current), HC-05 Bluetooth classic UART, 4xAA NiMH motor supply and separate USB power bank for Uno, common GND, wiring/resistor divider for 3.3V HC-05 RX, fail-safe stop on communication loss. Inventory photo-only untested; verify existing accessories before buying. Wi-Fi ESP32 is optional alternate architecture.
